summary: One step of a violet-breadcrumb: a link, or plain text for the current page.

usage.text: It renders a link only when it is not current and href is relative, http(s) or mailto. Any other scheme, or no href, renders plain text. The current item is never a link.
A "/" separator follows each item except the current one and is hidden from assistive technology. The separator slot replaces the glyph.
